Indian Railways Approves Bihar Rail Line Project Worth Rs 976 Crore

Indian Railways has approved a project to lay new railway lines in Bihar at a cost of Rs 976 crore. The project aims to increase the number of trains on the Delhi-Howrah route. This development is expected to enhance rail connectivity and capacity in the region.
